BiblicalUsage: Shomrayin is the Aramaic name for Samaria, and it appears in the letters written against the rebuilding of Jerusalem. The peoples settled in the cities of Samaria wrote to the king, and the king's answer went back to those who dwelt in Samaria, in the days when every letter was a weapon against God's work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe opposition often arrives by letter before it arrives by force. The men of Samaria wrote to stop the building, and I hold that God's work has always had to outlast its paperwork.
